name: Blackwolf River
summary: Blackwolf River runs from Cragpool Lake through Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains. The Venture Company's logging and industrial work has fouled its waters.

sections.title: Industrial Runoff
sections.body: Blackwolf River runs through Windshear Crag, fed by Cragpool Lake. Venture Company loggers cut the surrounding woods with heavy machinery and buzzsaws. Sludge, oil, and logging waste drain into the current. The river carries the cost of the company's work through the basin.

faq.q: Where does the Blackwolf River start and lead?
faq.answer: Blackwolf River flows down from Cragpool Lake through the logged basin of Windshear Crag.

faq.q: Why is the river water polluted?
faq.answer: The Venture Company logs across Windshear Crag with heavy machinery. Runoff, waste, and clear-cutting drain into the river.

faq.q: Who is currently operating along the river?
faq.answer: The Venture Company works along the river, harvesting lumber and operating machinery in the valley despite resistance from local wildlife and native inhabitants.

angles.text: As a druid, you can see how goblin timber work fouls Blackwolf River, an affront to the Cenarion Circle and those who revere Kalimdor's untamed waters.
As a tauren, you see the earth scarred and the waters fouled by outsiders seeking profit. It strengthens your resolve to cleanse Stonetalon of reckless industrial blight.
